create_VisualEncoder_with_resnet: create a VisualEncoder instance using a ResNet backbone config with default 128x128 image size
create_VisualEncoder_with_vit: create a VisualEncoder instance using a ViT or BEiT backbone config with global pooling enabled
forward_VisualEncoder: run a forward pass through the VisualEncoder on a batch of image tensors to get visual embeddings
get_loaded_backbone_data: get the backbone model, embedding dimension, and visual transform from an existing VisualEncoder instance
review_VisualEncoder_freeze_backbone: review the VisualEncoder freeze_backbone logic that disables gradients for ResNet backbones during forward pass
